title: Snooky Young in Hampton's band
summary: Dance asks about Snooky Young and Cobb praises him as a good trumpeter with a round tone.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Well now, there was just one other person, before we leave, Lionel -- did Snooky Young come up then when you were there?
Snooky was in there, yeah, out of Dayton, Ohio.
Well now -- oh, no, he had been in Lunceford's band.
He was in Lunceford's band too.
So that was just another band (inaudible).
I guess so, but Snooky was a good man. He was a good trumpet player. Had good chops, good round tone and a terrific musician.
